name: histone_modification_benchmark_v1
description: Benchmark for predicting histone modification signals from DNA sequence. It measures sequence-model performance on classifying presence/absence (or level) of specific histone marks using curated genomic examples, enabling comparison of models that learn regulatory sequence features. Typical evaluation focuses on discrimination metrics derived from held-out genomic regions.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark introduced by DNA-LLM for evaluating sequence models on epigenomic prediction tasks; primarily used in the computational genomics community.
